context: Kenji and Ren in the small art studio working through revisions on a long manga chapter.
purpose: Creative editing dialogue; structural choices in storytelling.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: この編、展開が早すぎる気がする。
lines.en: I feel this arc moves too fast.
lines.style: soft male artist voice, thoughtful critique

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ほな、どこを伸ばすべきや思う?
lines.en: So where do you reckon we extend it?
lines.style: Kansai senior artist, deliberate questioning, soft real warmth audible threading throughout delivery

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 中盤の感情の部分かな。
lines.style: analytical young man, gentle certainty, soft real warmth audible threading throughout delivery

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: なるほど、確かにそこ薄いな。
lines.en: Right — yeah, that part is thin.
lines.style: agreeable Kansai mentor, slow nod tone

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 修正は明日までに終わらせます。
lines.en: I'll finish the revisions by tomorrow.
lines.style: committed adult male, professional steady, soft real warmth audible threading throughout delivery

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 無理すなや。完成度の方が大事や。
lines.en: Don't push too hard. Quality matters more.
lines.style: caring Kansai elder voice, gentle firmness

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、構成から見直します。
lines.en: Yes, I'll review the structure from scratch.
lines.style: respectful young artist, determined, soft real warmth audible threading throughout delivery

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ええ判断や。線も丁寧にな。
lines.en: Good call. Keep the linework careful too.
lines.style: approving Kansai mentor, warm guidance, soft real warmth audible threading throughout delivery

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 線の太さ、もう少し変化つけます。
lines.en: I'll vary the line weight a bit more.
lines.style: focused young male, refining tone, soft real warmth audible threading throughout delivery

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: うん、それで物語に深みが出るで。
lines.style: wise Kansai voice, patient teaching, soft real warmth audible threading throughout delivery

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ありがとうございます、頑張ります。
lines.en: Thank you, I'll give it my all.
lines.style: humble young artist, sincere gratitude, soft real warmth audible threading throughout delivery

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ええ仕事しよな、ふたりで。
lines.en: Let's do good work, the two of us.
lines.style: tender Kansai mentor, brotherly closeness, soft real warmth audible threading throughout delivery
